blocks.x: Digital Commerce & Experience Acceleration: the composed architecture, the platforms underneath and the metric the program is judged on.
The problem this solution exists for
Commerce platforms bend under peaks, conversion leaks at uninstrumented steps, and cloud cost per order is discovered on the invoice — not engineered.
Our approach

We rebuild the commerce runtime for event-speed (search, cart, checkout), instrument funnel economics end-to-end, engineer peak readiness with load and chaos drills, and wire AI merchandising under evaluation discipline.
Components

items: Event-driven search, cart and checkout paths
Load modeling, chaos drills, capacity policy
Ranking and content with eval gates

blocks.x: Platform stack
The solution runs on Dataq Forge and Dataq Nexus: The governed data estate every AI program needs. Enterprise decisions in milliseconds — with a full evidence trail for each decision.
How it runs in an engagement

items: Baseline metrics for this problem locked with owners; current-state decision/data flow mapped in two weeks.
Gated pilot on bounded scope with the testable criterion agreed by finance before the first build sprint.
Staged rollout on the platform stack with SLOs, replay evidence and operator enablement.
Challenger models and policies quarterly; conformance monitoring; annual value audit against baseline.

blocks.x: What you get

items: Reference architecture adapted to your estate, with the integration contracts itemized.
The composed capability live on bounded scope, with audit evidence produced automatically.
Runbooks, SLO catalog and the named-pod accountability chain for production.
Baseline pack, measurement method and the quarterly review template your finance team signs.

blocks.x: Prerequisites and data readiness
Data readiness matters more than data volume: the diagnostic phase surfaces gaps, and the design phase prices them — no program pretends the estate is cleaner than it is.
Proof

items: Real-time fraud decisioning on instant rails: 38% lower fraud losses at a higher approval rate
KYC refresh backlog cleared: 70% faster cycles with agentic file assembly

blocks.x: Industry fit

Deployed across Retail & Consumer Goods, Technology & SaaS, Telecom, Media & Entertainment. Each industry play adjusts the regulatory frame, the integration surface and the KPI set — the pattern stays, the physics changes.
Outcomes we commit to
How a delivery runs

Programs run on a fixed rhythm so progress is visible from week one. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
